title: Avoid double quotes when generating Liquid merge tags in email templates
answers: Why does a person property merge tag break email links with a Liquid parse error?
Why does an email merge tag render as a blank value in workflow emails?
How to format person property merge tags for Liquid templates in workflow emails?
body:
Symptom: Picking a person property merge tag in a workflow email breaks HTML link href attributes with a Liquid parse error ("expected '|' before filter") or renders an empty string.
Root cause: frontend/src/scenes/hog-functions/email-templater/emailTemplaterLogic.tsx:emailTemplaterLogic used double quotes in merge tags ({{person.properties["name"]}}), terminating double-quoted HTML attributes or failing entity decoding.
Fix pattern: In frontend/src/scenes/hog-functions/email-templater/emailTemplaterLogic.tsx:buildPersonPropertyMergeValue, emit dot notation for bare identifiers and escaped single quotes within brackets for all other property names.
Constraints: Applies to Liquid merge tag generation for email templates; does not fix unhandled HTML entity decoding in backend Liquid renderers.
applies: Workflow email templater merge tags in frontend hog functions
